summary: Join our Financial Stability and Systemic Risk Assessment Training to master risk evaluation techniques and strengthen your financial decision-making skills.
lede: Financial stability assessment helps risk and policy professionals identify vulnerabilities and understand how shocks can spread across institutions. This class is for analysts, supervisors, economists, and policy specialists who use financial data to assess system-wide risk. Learners interpret financial soundness indicators, evaluate concentration and interconnectedness, and develop stress scenarios that inform macroprudential options.
audienceIntro: This systemic risk assessment course is designed for professionals who identify financial vulnerabilities, test shock transmission, oversee prudential indicators, or brief decision-makers on system-wide risk. It suits analytical and policy roles that already work with financial statements, risk metrics, economic data, or supervisory information.
modules: IMF FSI Systemic Risk Assessment Training
Systemic Risk Assessment for Emerging Shocks
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop capable of running Microsoft Excel and accessing Microsoft Power BI Desktop or an equivalent approved visualization environment. Gephi may require installation before the course, subject to your organization’s software controls. TrainingCred provides simplified datasets and exercise templates; no proprietary institutional data is required.
